x: John ran the latter half of his stage with Francis of Westbury who was credited with the day's fastest of 28:34 against John's 30:42! Laurie O'Hara took us up to 3rd, Geoff North maintained it and Bill Dance passed the Reading man and held off Bob Holt to finish a worthy second and a moral 1st.

John dashed to the front, ostentatiously asked for guidance out of the grounds, and disappeared up Saffron Lane shoulder to shoulder with Mike Fuller - Fowler, Haslam, Francis and Kirkham in hot pursuit.
Fastest of Day: Presland (SAC) 15:13, Wands (Hill) 15:24, Francis (Hill) 15:31
